name: Apple
description: Crisp and juicy apples picked at peak ripeness from local orchards. Perfect for snacking, baking, or making fresh cider.

name: Tomato
description: Vine-ripened tomatoes bursting with flavor. A staple of summer markets, ideal for salads, sauces, and sandwiches.

name: Strawberry
description: Sweet, fragrant strawberries fresh from the farm. A seasonal delight best enjoyed within days of picking.

name: Carrot
description: Earthy, crunchy carrots grown in rich local soil. Great raw, roasted, or juiced.

name: Potato
description: Versatile local potatoes perfect for roasting, mashing, or frying. Available year-round at most markets.

name: Basil
description: Aromatic fresh basil, essential for Italian dishes and homemade pesto. Best used the same day for maximum flavor.

name: Mint
description: Cool, refreshing mint leaves perfect for teas, cocktails, and garnishes. Easy to grow and always in demand.

name: Spinach
description: Tender, nutrient-packed spinach leaves. Best in spring and fall, perfect for salads and sauteed dishes.

name: Pumpkin
description: Classic autumn pumpkins for cooking, baking pies, or decoration. A seasonal favorite from local farms.

name: Corn
description: Sweet, freshly picked corn on the cob. A summer essential best grilled or boiled the same day.

name: Milk
description: Fresh, unpasteurized milk from local dairy farms. Rich in nutrients and free from artificial additives.

name: Cheese
description: Artisanal cheeses crafted by local producers. From creamy brie to sharp cheddar, a wide variety available.

name: Brown Rice
description: Nutritious whole-grain brown rice sourced from local Vietnamese rice farms.

name: Jasmine Rice
description: Fragrant jasmine rice with soft texture, grown by local rice farmers.

name: Oats
description: Whole oats suitable for breakfast bowls, baking, and homemade granola.

name: Quinoa
description: Wholesome quinoa grains packed with plant-based protein and nutrients.

name: Honey
description: Pure natural honey collected from local beekeepers and flowering farms.

name: Strawberry Jam
description: Small-batch strawberry jam made from ripe local strawberries and natural ingredients.

name: Mango Jam
description: Sweet and fruity mango jam prepared from locally grown ripe mangoes.
